description: Shows commit annotations for a file, grouped by commit. Returns structured blame data with deduplicated commit metadata (hash, author, email, date) and their attributed lines.

detectCopies.description: Detect lines copied from other files (-C)

detectMoves.description: Detect moved lines within a file (-M)

endLine.description: End line number for blame range

ignoreRevsFile.description: Path to file listing revisions to ignore (--ignore-revs-file), e.g. .git-blame-ignore-revs

path.description: Repository path. Authoritative — when omitted, the server uses its own process working directory (its launch dir, not the caller's cwd). Callers in a git worktree or other directory MUST pass this explicitly to avoid operating on the wrong repo.

since.description: Limit blame history to a date range (--since)

startLine.description: Start line number for blame range

name: blame
title: Git Blame
